description: This file defines interfaces and structures for handling chunk-based file formats, including initialization, reading, writing, and searching for chunks within a file. It appears to be part of a larger system dealing with chunk serialization and file management.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a chunkfile structure for reading or writing chunk format data.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a chunkfile structure.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the number of chunks in a chunkfile.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a chunk with specified ID, size, and data write function to the chunkfile.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes the entire chunkfile to disk or output.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads the table of contents from a memory-mapped file for chunk management.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Finds a chunk by ID in the chunkfile and provides its position and size.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads a specific chunk identified by ID and processes it with a callback function.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the object ID algorithm used, based on the algorithm's structure.

ctags.name: chunk_read_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const unsigned char * chunk_start,size_t chunk_size,void * data)
